create_meta_optimizer: create a MetaOptimizer instance with network configuration kwargs for learning-to-learn optimization
build_meta_loss: build a meta-loss computation graph by unrolling an optimizee through multiple gradient steps with an RNN optimizer
run_meta_minimize: run meta-minimization by combining meta_loss with an Adam optimizer to learn the optimizer parameters
save_meta_optimizer: save trained MetaOptimizer network weights to disk for later restoration
review_MetaOptimizer_class: review the MetaOptimizer class that implements a learning-to-learn optimizer with internal RNN taking gradients as input
